name: CashBook
one_liner: Ramp for Indian Businesses - UPI Wallets for Employee Expenses

founders.name: Vivek Kumar
founders.title: Founder
founders.note: Hi Vivek, love CashBook's UPI expense management for businesses. I built RoundUp, an open-source UPI expense tracker that rounds up spare. Hope to connect here!
founders.followup: Thanks for connecting, Vivek. I have been following CashBook because your focus on UPI wallets for Indian businesses is highly relevant to the space I am exploring with my open-source tracker, RoundUp. Building for the Indian UPI ecosystem has its unique challenges. How do you navigate the API limitations when managing real-time business expenses?
